I am 18 and I help my family farm here in Zomba, where I learned farming from my mother and father even though I went to school for a few years. This bean plot is very small, only 0.09 hectares, so I will not buy chemical fertilizer because it is too expensive and beans do not need it like maize does. I will put a small amount of manure from our goats on it because the land is ours, and I will use the bean seed we saved from last season. My family will weed and harvest together, so I do not need to pay anyone.
